## Training data

**Regenerated rows.** 400,000 conversations of the Datakit SFT mixture (the data the 09.21 model was fine-tuned on), whose assistant turns were regenerated by [`open-athena/Grug-67B-A2B-Datakit-SFT-262K-2026.09.21-dr-doom`](https://huggingface.co/open-athena/Grug-67B-A2B-Datakit-SFT-262K-2026.09.21-dr-doom) itself, at T=1, top-p 1, at most 32,768 new tokens per turn within the row's 32,768-token window. The drafter trained on the regenerated text (loss on the regenerated assistant tokens only), and no original reply text is in its training data.

- **Which conversations.** Drawn uniformly without replacement (seed 0) from the 6,464,687 rows of the Datakit train split (the first 99.9% of 6,471,159 rows; the last 0.1% is the held-out validation split used for the evaluation below).
- **Regeneration statistics.** 2,467,745,475 regenerated (supervised) tokens, 6,169 per row on average; 40,914 rows (10.2%) reached the 32,768-token limit and 1,979 ended at the row's total-length window; 0 request errors. Two jobs on 2 GB200 nodes: 12 h (stopped by the time limit, resumable) and 5 h 09 min (finished the remaining rows). The merged dataset is 400,000 rows and 3,796,301,131 tokens; 0.5% of the rows were held out for the end-of-run validation.
- **Draft vocabulary.** Built from this regenerated text: the 32,000 most frequent supervised tokens (of 124,910 distinct) cover 98.44% of them.

[`regen_stats.json`](regen_stats.json) holds these numbers and [`regen_rows.npy`](regen_rows.npy) the 400,000 sampled row indices in draw order (rows of the Datakit dataset described by the [itw run's data manifest](https://huggingface.co/atutej/dspark_grug-67b-a2b-datakit-sft-dr-doom_datakit-sft-mix_itw-160k-20261020/blob/main/training_data_manifest.json), in shard order; recomputed from the seed and checked to equal the regenerated rows).
